t: Founded in 1752 by Alaungpaya, a village headman who reunited Burma within a few years and founded Rangoon.
Its armies destroyed Ayutthaya in 1767, repelled four Qing invasions and conquered Arakan, Assam and Manipur.
Three wars with Britain, in 1824–1826, 1852 and 1885, stripped it of territory and ended in annexation.
dyk: At Mindon’s Kuthodaw Pagoda in Mandalay the entire Pali Buddhist canon is carved on 729 marble slabs, each housed in its own small shrine.
ev: Alaungpaya proclaims himself king at Moksobo (Shwebo)
Alaungpaya captures Pegu and reunites Burma
The last of four Qing invasions ends in the peace of Kaungton
Treaty of Yandabo ends the First Anglo-Burmese War
British forces take Mandalay; King Thibaw is exiled

f.capital: Shwebo; later Sagaing, Ava, Amarapura and from 1857 Mandalay
